label: 163 forward as requirement
definition: Forward AS requirement (G3): run159 multi-product co-opt with each AS product (RegUp/RRS/ECRS/NonSpin) set from a forward formula of forecast drivers (net-load, ramp, VRE-share, forecast-error, load-ratio) instead of the measured AS Plan. Modeled-vs-measured requirement MW holds (total up-AS 0.94/0.98/1.02x). Acute/tail: 2025 clean (MAE 2.5), 2023 acute held; 2024 May acute under-fires ($21.7 vs measured-req $40) — ERCOT's discretionary day-specific acute AS uplift has no forward-driver analogue (not pinned; honesty gate). Measured DAM-AS overlay (run157) stays the pre-RTC+B bridge for the discretionary component.
